## 5. Regulation & Policy

**2026-06-13 — State AG coalition investigation into OpenAI reported**  
Link: [WSJ — OpenAI Investigated by Coalition of State Attorneys General](https://www.wsj.com/tech/openai-investigated-by-coalition-of-state-attorneys-general-088a3928)  
A coalition of state attorneys general has reportedly opened an investigation into OpenAI. The reported New York subpoena seeks documents related to advertising, user data, minors and seniors, model sycophancy, and company policies. OpenAI said it takes the concerns seriously and intends to engage constructively.  
**Why it matters:** This moves AI consumer-protection scrutiny beyond federal and EU channels into coordinated U.S. state enforcement, with potential implications for ChatGPT product design, advertising claims, age-sensitive safeguards, and data practices.
